checks: Source modules execute from hash-verified bytes; GGUF is a bounded regular-file nofollow header read with exact digest and extent.
Publisher chat template bytes equal pinned GGUF header metadata; thinking is explicitly disabled.
Native vocab.bin reconstruction matches fixed digest and exact five-key admitted tokenizer identity.
All twelve sealed prompts match exact rendered bytes and token IDs; four retained message shapes also match.

Header EOS248046 is distinguished from BOS/padding248044; both token strings/types are checked. Production native source stops on geometry.eos or248046, while miniature source stops only on its own EOS.
Decode preserves whitespace and terminal token strings; invalid token IDs refuse. Facade separately admits native stop IDs and removes only the final terminal ID for presentation.
Input roles, message counts, UTF-8 text bytes and encoded/decoded token counts are bounded; wrong header/source/identity/vocabulary pins refuse.
limitations: CPU header/tokenizer/template tests only; no native/model payload/device/HTTP execution or throughput claim.
Library versions are recorded by codec provenance; the implementation does not pin package wheels. Current tested renderer output is covered by retained fixtures.

Publisher template intentionally trims message content and can render conversation history differently from exact saved raw IDs; checkpoint reuse must continue to require exact token-prefix equality and fall back to prefill on mismatch.
